1.title: How Our Photographer Took This 9/11 Photo
1.summary: Our photographer Chang W. Lee describes how he took the picture of the north tower of the World Trade Center collapsing on Sept. 11, 2001.

2.title: Boy, 15, Drifted for Days on an Overturned Boat Before Rescue
2.summary: The teenager survived in the Bering Sea off Alaska without food or water before a fishing vessel pulled him to safety, the Coast Guard said.

3.title: Pickles! (Live From the Minnesota State Fair)
3.summary: World-class pickle experts explain how to find a great one, and how to make your own safely at home.

4.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
4.summary: Thai police also arrested a suspected female accomplice with whom the monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was filmed having sex.

5.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
5.summary: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.

6.title: For China, a Mock A.I. Attack on WeChat Signals a Dangerous New Era
6.summary: The demonstration of a potent cyberweapon has exposed China’s vulnerabilities and added to the urgency of A.I. safety talks between Beijing and Washington.
